### 2026-10-01 — I  have taken my time to rewire and organise my piano so that all the components can stay on the breadboard intead of being seperated from it, This has helped me further confirm that all my wires and

**0.5h**

I  have taken my time to rewire and organise my piano so that all the components can stay on the breadboard intead of being seperated from it, This has helped me further confirm that all my wires and connections are optimal and manageable!. and my current code has not needed any changes since it's working perfectly, but i might find ways to make it more simple!

### 2026-10-01 — Since i have never used this language, it took me a while to implement some features i've been thinking about, for example the LEDs switched from plain to PWM-driven so they glow at a variable brightn

**2h**

Since i have never used this language, it took me a while to implement some features i've been thinking about, for example the LEDs switched from plain to PWM-driven so they glow at a variable brightness instead of on & off. Releasing keys now fades its LED out over 200ms instead of instant cut off. and after 4 seconds of no input, the LEDs drift into a slow breathing glow until you play again. I also switched all the variables into a singular array for the keys so i dont have to make 3 seperate arrays! But my overall hardware strucure is still the same!
